new_clusters.summary: Both new completion-provider tests call resolveFunc() with no argument although the plugin-ui contract declares resolve(TableIdentifier | null), so typecheck fails with two TS2554 errors and the change cannot pass CI.

The alerting rule editor renders SqlExpr with an empty queries array, so the metadata path's queries.filter finds no matching frame and column autocomplete can never resolve there regardless of quoting.
The getFields jest mock in the completion-provider tests is dead setup: it is reachable only through columns.resolve, which neither test invokes, and it is never asserted on.
The two completion-provider tests duplicate identical setup and differ only in fixture and expectation, so they would be clearer as a single table-driven it.each case.

No test feeds an identifier containing an embedded backtick, so every suite exercises only the benign spaces input and none would fail if the quoting were weakened on the inputs that make it a sanitization control rather than a formatter.
Considered whether the client-side ALLOWED_FUNCTIONS list has drifted from the server's parser allow-list; verified it is a strict subset, so the drift is fail-closed and untouched by this change.
Considered whether the SQL formatter mangles backtick-quoted identifiers in the generated initial query; ran the formatter over a quoted table name and the output was byte-identical, so refuted.
Considered that the completion item's name is left unquoted while its completion text is quoted; dismissed as correct because name is the suggestion-list label and completion is the inserted text.
Considered whether the query.table narrowing before the quoting call is sound; dismissed because the early return on a falsy table narrows to string and empty/undefined behave as intended.

Considered whether the providerGetter test's as-any casts for the monaco and language arguments hide a live type mismatch; dismissed because monaco is unused by the function body and language is only spread.
Considered resource amplification on the SQL expression execution path; dismissed because the cell limits, output limits, timeout and disabled file writes bound it and are untouched by this change.
Considered autocomplete request amplification, where each column resolution fires a data-source query POST; dismissed as pre-existing, toggle-gated and untouched by this change.
